summary: A strategic + doctrine arc, not a code cut. Assessed the roadmap and answered the operator's interoperability questions (timestamp a Facebook post — yes, witness-grade today; timestamp between — the existing co-sign primitive; the bridges — the Phase 3 deeplink exists, the everyday capture bridge does not). Wrote a capture-bridge phase sketch (briefs/2026-05-22-capture-bridge-phase-sketch.md) with three tiers — Web Share Target, native share extension, browser extension — and an App Store assessment (not hard to pass: no money, no exchange, no money transmission; the only real gate is Apple guideline 4.2, which the native share extension itself clears). Added PLAN.md Phase 4.5 (tabbed home + PWA-first capture bridge). Recorded decisions D-07 (capture bridge PWA-first; native + App Store deferred to v1.5) and D-08 (tabbed information architecture). Logged six ideas, the largest being the operator's Mycelium People-network vision — the People tab is not a contacts list, it is a discovered, propagated peer network where mutual handshakes make people leaves in each other's trees, and that is Layer 3, spec-blocked by D-04. Finally, converted the operator's recurring stay-grounded directive into a mechanism: a UserPromptSubmit grounding-gate hook in a new committed .claude/settings.json.

why.text: Operator drove a roadmap + interoperability strategy discussion, then asked to make the stay-grounded directive a hook so it does not depend on being repeated, then asked to verify everything transfers durably to the repo for clean session-to-session handoff. Mechanism over prose (CLAUDE_ROOT.md non-negotiable #5): the grounding directive became a check that fires. Verify-don't-trust: the People-tab vision was caught as Layer 3 and routed to the spec rather than improvised into a tab.

files_changed: PLAN.md (modify), decisions.md (modify), ideas.md (modify), briefs/2026-05-22-capture-bridge-phase-sketch.md (new), .claude/settings.json (new) — 7 commits 80d0b5f..198d737 plus this comms refresh
outcome.tests_passing: Unchanged — no source code touched since ff5c37e (the elegant restyle), where all four gates were green at 19/19. The strategic commits are docs + config only.
outcome.notes: Working tree clean, branch fully pushed, main brought up to date with all strategic commits. Comms handoff files refreshed so a new session resumes cleanly. [FEEDBACK->Foreman]: a headless-screenshot capability would let the Carpenter self-verify UI work instead of leaning on the operator's phone loop — restated from the restyle session.

uncertainty: The grounding-gate hook reliably injects the directive on every prompt, but a hook injects an instruction — it cannot physically force file reads. The only true hard interlock is the harness already refusing Edit without a prior Read. The hook hardens the surrounding discipline; it is not a literal gate.
next: Build the tabbed home (Phase 4.5): Journal and Identity as the two live tabs, Captured as an honest coming-soon tab, People deferred to MYCELIUM_NETWORK_SPEC.md. Tabs as a segmented control under the header (a bottom bar collides with the floating + New entry button). Operator-side: finish Resend custom SMTP + the email plumbing (the v1 launch blocker). Then Capture Bridge Tier 1, then write the Mycelium spec.
